data.gender_notes: Ghumaysa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Ghumaysa means 'trusting' or 'dependent'. Derived from the verb 'ghamasa', which means 'to trust' or 'to believe', this name carries a deep sense of faith and reliance on Allah. The name Ghumaysa carries the meaning “Trusting, Dependent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ghumaysa usually hope their child will grow to embody trusting, dependent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes trust and submission to Allah.
data.etymology: Ghumaysa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Trusting, Dependent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ghumaysa total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: Ghumaysa is a beautiful Arabic name, rooted in the rich Islamic tradition. The name signifies a strong bond of trust and dependence on Allah, embodying the cornerstone of Islamic teachings - tawakkul or complete trust and reliance on Allah. This name embodies a sense of inner peace, faith, and commitment to the divine will of Allah, reinforcing the value of trust and reliance in personal relationships, as well as in one's spiritual journey.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Ghumaysa is deeply connected to the concept of tawakkul in Islam. This name serves as a constant reminder of the importance of trusting in Allah's infinite wisdom and ultimate plan for one's life, offering a source of solace and comfort in moments of doubt and uncertainty.
